name: Lumbar Compression Fracture - Traumatic
definition: Acute traumatic compression fracture of a lumbar vertebral body, typically involving anterior column failure without the burst-fracture pattern of retropulsion.

typical: Acute focal low-back pain after trauma

investigations.principle: CT defines morphology and excludes posterior involvement; MRI is selected for neural or ligamentous concern.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Analgesia and mobilization plan after stability assessment
amber: If posterior wall involvement, neurological symptoms or instability is suspected, manage as a higher-risk fracture.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna concepts may complement rehabilitation only after modern stability assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Acute traumatic compression fracture of a lumbar vertebral body, typically involving anterior column failure without the burst-fracture pattern of retropulsion.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
